newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one - March 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one - March 20.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Thursday:

* A partial New York state takeover of utility firm Long Island Lighting Co would cut electrical rates on the island up to 23 percent. The deal would also involve a $7 billion municipal bond issue, the largest ever.
* American Airlines and negotiators from its pilots union reach a tentative pact on new contract terms.
* President Clinton chose George Tenet as his new nominee for director of the Central Intelligence Agency.
* The U.S. Supreme Courts heard testimony about efforts to regulate sexually explicit material on the Internet.

* One of Indonesian businessman James Riady's companies paid Webster Hubbell about $100,000 one week after a visit to the White House. Payments were made at a time when Hubbell was facing an unfolding criminal investigation.
* Artist Willem de Kooning dies at age 92 in New York.
* Computer security experts will announce they have found the key to an electronic code to protect the privacy of calls made on new digital cellular telephones.
* The Helsinki summit meeting attended by Clinton and Russia's President Yeltsin comes at the end of a month of bargaining to gain Russian tolerance of NATO expansion.
